settings.question: Can I open and inspect the package before paying?
settings.answer: Yes! Our courier policy allows you to inspect your items before handing over cash. If anything doesn't match your expectations, you simply return it with the courier and pay only the delivery fee.

settings.question: How long does shipping take across Egyptian Governorates?
settings.answer: Cairo & Giza orders arrive within 24 to 48 hours. Alexandria, Delta, and Canal cities take 2 to 3 days. Upper Egypt and Red Sea take 3 to 4 business days.

settings.question: How does the 14-day exchange policy work?
settings.answer: If you need a different size or color, simply message our WhatsApp support with your order number. Our courier will bring the new size and collect the old one directly at your door.

settings.question: How do I choose my size?
settings.answer: Click the 'Size Guide' button on any product page to see chest, length, and weight recommendations. All items are true to size unless described as oversized.
